Running the gate under venv/bin/python manufactures a 9-code phantom over-ceiling report (index 63 vs 44, union-attr 181 vs 156, operator 83 vs 73) that no commit can explain and no fix can clear. ALWAYS measure with venv-mypy-gate/ (scripts/bootstrap-mypy-gate-venv.sh); scripts/run-sweep.sh ratchets now refuses to run the gate any other way.
